title: [Request] 绘画能支持记忆上一次选择的模型
body:
### 🥰 需求描述

目前每次打开会回到gpt-image，无法记忆之前的选择
希望能支持模型的记忆

### 🧐 解决方案

像聊天的模型选择一样，增加模型选择记忆

#### 🔀 变更说明 | Description of Change

This PR implements persistent model selection memory for the image generation feature, addressing GitHub Issue #9154.

**Key Features:**
- **Persistent Model Memory**: Last selected image model & provider are saved to global status and restored on return
- **Smart Initialization**: Proper dependency chain (login state → provider runtime → image config initialization)  
- **Authentication Aware**: Only restore previous selections for logged-in users; anonymous users get default configuration
- **Graceful Error Handling**: Missing or disabled models fallback to defaults without breaking the UI
- **Loading States**: Proper skeleton screens during initialization process

**Technical Implementation:**
- Added `lastSelectedImageModel/Provider` fields to global status for persistence
- Created `useFetchAiImageConfig` hook managing initialization sequence
- Added `isInitAiProviderRuntimeState` state for precise dependency tracking  
- Refactored shared logic between model configuration functions
- Enhanced error boundaries with meaningful fallback behavior

The image generation feature now remembers user's model selection just like the chat interface, providing a seamless experience across sessions.

#### 📝 补充信息 | Additional Information

**Testing:** All existing tests pass, and new dependency tracking has been validated.  
**Performance:** Initialization only occurs for authenticated users when dependencies are ready, avoiding unnecessary API calls.  
**Backward Compatibility:** Existing users will see default model selection initially, then their choices will be remembered going forward.

Closes #9154

## Summary by Sourcery

Enable persistent memory for image generation model selection by storing user choices in global status, restoring them on load with proper dependency tracking via a new hook, and ensuring graceful error handling and loading states.

New Features:
- Persist and restore the last selected image generation model and provider across sessions
- Automatically initialize the image configuration for authenticated users once global status and AI provider runtime state are ready
- Introduce useFetchAiImageConfig hook to manage initialization sequence and loading state in the ConfigPanel

Enhancements:
- Extract common model parameter setup into prepareModelConfigState to consolidate initialization logic
- Show a loading skeleton in the ConfigPanel until the image configuration is fully initialized
- Implement graceful fallback when restoring missing or disabled models to avoid UI breakage
- Delay AI provider runtime fetch until authentication state is loaded and skip in deprecated editions
